before_snippet:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import solve

# Using a non-standard dtype like uint8 that linalg doesn't support
A = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1]], dtype=np.uint8)
b = np.array([1, 2], dtype=np.uint8)

try:
    x = solve(A, b)
    # In 1.17.1, this might work with casting
except Exception:
    pass
title: scipy.linalg functions now reject non-LAPACK dtypes
